# Omium

> Omium is an AI agent observability and reliability platform. It traces
> execution, diagnoses failures, and recovers multi-agent workflows from any
> checkpoint. This file lists the canonical documentation pages that an AI
> assistant should ground answers against.

## Fundamentals

- [What is Omium](https://omium.ai/docs/fundamentals/what-is-omium.md): One-paragraph definition of the platform, who it is for, and what it is not.
- [Quickstart](https://omium.ai/docs/fundamentals/quickstart.md): Install the SDK, set an Access Token, run a Workflow Run end-to-end in five minutes.
- [Key concepts](https://omium.ai/docs/fundamentals/key-concepts.md): Workflows, Steps, Checkpoints, Spans, Traces, Policies, Routes — definitions and relationships.

## SDK

- [Python SDK](https://omium.ai/docs/sdk/python.md): Decorators (@workflow, @step, @checkpoint), the Client object, retries, timeouts, parallel execution.
- [CLI](https://omium.ai/docs/sdk/cli.md): omium run, runs list/show/watch/resume, traces tail, policies attach/detach.

## API reference

- [API overview](https://omium.ai/docs/api-reference/overview.md): Base URL, authentication, errors, pagination, idempotency, versioning.
- [Runs](https://omium.ai/docs/api-reference/runs.md): POST /v1/runs, GET /v1/runs/{id}, POST /v1/runs/{id}/resume.
- [Checkpoints](https://omium.ai/docs/api-reference/checkpoints.md): List, restore, retention windows.
- [Traces](https://omium.ai/docs/api-reference/traces.md): List traces, stream Spans via Server-Sent Events.
- [Policies](https://omium.ai/docs/api-reference/policies.md): Attach, detach, evaluation order, audit log.
- [Webhooks](https://omium.ai/docs/api-reference/webhooks.md): Event types, HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, replay protection.
- [Errors catalog](https://omium.ai/docs/api-reference/errors-catalog.md): Every error type the API can return, with cause and resolution.

## Guides

- [Resume a Workflow Run from any checkpoint](https://omium.ai/docs/guides/resume-from-checkpoint.md): Tutorial using the resume API and the run watcher.
- [Stream Spans in real time](https://omium.ai/docs/guides/stream-spans-realtime.md): Build a span tail using the SSE traces endpoint.
- [Route between Sonnet and Haiku](https://omium.ai/docs/guides/llm-routing-by-latency.md): Latency, cost, and quality budgets in routing policy.
- [Deny-by-default tool policies](https://omium.ai/docs/guides/deny-by-default-tool-policies.md): Lock down tool calls with explicit allowlists.

## LLM context

- [llms-full.txt](https://omium.ai/llms-full.txt): Single-file concatenation of every documentation page above. Use for offline RAG ingestion.
- [MCP server](https://omium.ai/docs/llm-context/mcp-server.md): How to point Cursor or Claude Code at Omium's live documentation via the Model Context Protocol.

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://omium.ai/docs/release-notes/changelog-archive.md): Versioned release notes.
- [Status page](https://status.omium.ai): Live system health.
